summary: Soft cap on concurrent vehicles at the depot; needs vehicle_penalty.
range: Integer. Soft — requires vehicle_penalty to take effect.
businessRules: max_vehicles defines: Specify the maximum number of vehicles that the depot can service simultaneously. This is a soft constraint and requires vehicle_penalty to be provided along with it.
Must stay consistent with: depots.throughput.vehicle_penalty. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Numeric field; verify sign (positive/negative) and unit from spec.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Behavioral: exceeding max_vehicles incurs vehicle_penalty, not rejection.
